_comment: Server-owned encounter content. The authority is the only process that samples these tables; clients receive the result.
_policy: Encounter policy: every encounter resolves through a template (pack size 3/5, boss solo, boss with exactly two escorts), carries a stable encounter id and a maximum alive count, and only becomes active when its region's pack_count allows it. Pack sizes and boss patterns are data; the AI, placement validation and the death/respawn lifecycle live in encounter_director.gd + mob_base.gd.
_debug_seed_note: Reproducible encounter seed. Pass it as HPMMO_WORLD_SEED to replay an exact spawn layout; the world server uses it when the env var is unset.
_pattern_note: Boss attack patterns (Creature pass): anticipation -> release -> recovery. `anticipation` and `recovery` are seconds; the authority converts them to ticks and publishes the release tick with the telegraph, so the client-rendered warning is driven by the same clock that lands the damage.
_regions_note: Regions carry the separate pack-count setting and a spawn_area rect used when an encounter's region is chosen by weight (zones + weights). Hunting regions also carry `display` and `level_min`/`level_max`: the HUD names the region and colours its level band against the player's level; validate_encounters reports a pack whose level falls outside its region's band. Regions without a band (courtyard, castle) are not hunting grounds.
_encounters_note: The authored encounter list. Only the first `pack_count` encounters assigned to each region are active; the rest are authored content that waits for a pack-count change (and are reported by the director, never silently ignored). `zones` (id + weight) makes the region choice weighted; without it the fixed `zone` field is used.
_exclusions_note: Authored keep-outs on the new grounds. Lake water needs no entry: the encounter director rejects any point over water (GroundsLake.is_water_at) and steep ground.
_density_note: Metin2-style density v2 (2026-10-17): packs on a ~40 m jittered grid over the whole grounds (terrain-filtered: no lake, cliffs or safe zones); each belongs to its nearest hunting region. Generated by a one-off script, edit freely.
_monolith_types_note: Metin stones by type. Each monoliths[] entry names its `type` (default dark). A type: name, level, max_hp, exp_reward, respawn_ms, loot_table (loot_tables.json key), scene, spawn distances and the HP-threshold waves. monolith_config is the dark type's legacy block (kept for older readers).
